paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4 as of August 14, 2026, with a decrease of 3.03% from the prior close and an increase of 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions.

There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, including reports from Kalkine Media and Bloomberg regarding Fermi Inc.'s Q2 2026 SEC 10-Q report and a US subpoena related to Project Matador. The Bloomberg report states that Fermi Inc. received a subpoena for certain documents related to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q report, a SCHEDULE 13G/A, and multiple 8-K reports. The 10-Q report discloses a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, while the 8-K reports announce the appointment of a new CEO and other officers, as well as the disclosure of financial results for the second quarter. There has been one Form 4 filing in the feed.
